draftBefore.shortGloss: to drive; to handle; to manage
draftBefore.emotion: focused and steady, hands gripping the wheel while watching the road
notes: In Mexico, 'manejar' is the standard verb for 'to drive' a car. In other Spanish-speaking countries, you will frequently hear 'conducir' used instead.
Do not confuse 'manejar' with 'manipular', which often carries a negative connotation of influencing someone or something for personal gain.
